newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: David Doyle no longer MD of Doyle Hotels - statement.
newsitem.headline: David Doyle no longer MD of Doyle Hotels - statement.

text.p: The board of P.V. Doyle Holdings said on Thursday that David Doyle had ceased to be Managing Director of the group.
It said in a statement that he would remain as a non-executive director.
A senior executive team under E.P. Galvin's chairmanship would direct the group's operations in the interim. Bernadette Gallagher would continue as Deputy Chairman, it said.

"The group has a very experienced and able senior operational management team. The Executive Team will immediately progress the board's long-term strategic plan for the Group while directing the day to day running of the hotels," the statement said.
